pre_condition: fingerprint is a tuple whose elements are JSON-serializable values (strings, numbers, booleans, None, and nested tuples, lists, and dicts composed of JSON-serializable values).
post_condition: Returns a deterministic 64-character lowercase hexadecimal string (each character in [0-9a-f]) that is a cryptographic digest of fingerprint. The mapping from fingerprint to the returned string is a pure function: identical fingerprint tuples always produce identical digest strings. Distinct fingerprints produce distinct digests (no collisions for the input domain of finite-length tuples of JSON-serializable data).
